newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices fall on poor quality.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices fall on poor quality.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices fell due mainly to absence of overseas buyers and poor quality end-of-season teas at the weekly auction, brokers said.
Brokers said the absence of foreign buyers forced the traders to withdraw 36.84 percent of their offers.

Some 757,920 kgs of teas were sold at the auction. The average price was 54.47 taka per kg, 1.94 taka down from previous sale. The next auction will be held on March 4 with an expected offer of 850,000 kg of teas. ($1 = 42.75 taka)
